clan.name: ARJ 🗡 🥷
clan.description: Arj are recruiting players for both Gbg & Qi.Home to a fiercely fun team but we also like to keep things chill and drama-free. The goal is harmonious, convivial gameplay while still pushing for great results. In light of this we discourage chat regarding global strife , politics , and or religion. We support each other in all aspects of the game.We work as a team during key events.Looking for players who share similar values regarding respect , patience , communication, balance and gameplay . Applicants with developed treasury buildings are viewed favourably . We offer solid assistance with GB's. Full Boost & 2.0 GB Threads as standard Our minimum requirements are:3500 combined points between QI & GBG. 1 x GbG battle = 1 point, 1xQi enocunter = 10 points, GbG minimum =500 battles/season, the rest is up to you. First day of Gbg we as a guild choose Trial 1 Try Be active during competition weeks (focus shifts heavily then)Discord is preferred for coordination and races.Completion of GE is not compulsory, but 48 is the minimum . We open it fully.In memory of the guilds that made us who we are today, and the many founders and leaders who invested in their growth: Apocalypse Jukebox Rising Fist Taking Over TGBMessage any Founder or Leader if you're interested injoining and receiving our code of conduct agreement on application.
